name: Cinderella 99
summary: **Cinderella 99** is a [[kind:cultivar|cultivar]] bred by Rick "Mr. Soul" Campanella of [[breeder:Brothers Grimm Seeds]] in the mid-1990s. A cross of [[jack-herer]] and [[shiva-skunk]], it was stabilized from a single female plant, nicknamed Princess, through repeated backcrossing. Campanella documented the strain's creation online in 2000.
